items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn't Curtis Mosby have a partner? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember now.

ctx.x: Well I don't know you see because I didn't, I didn't know the musicians. I remember one theater, the Lincoln Theater in Los Angeles was where we would go every Sunday night and they would have a show. And I can only remember one fellow there and his name was Alton Reid, a drummer. He had the band in the theater.
But there was a club there called, the Club Alabam. It was run by Curtis Mosby. They had a beautiful band in there too.
What was his partner, Reb Spikes or something? Some such name? Didn't Curtis Mosby have a partner?
